inquiries.title: Graduate Admissions
inquiries.text: Prospective PhD students and postdocs should send a CV, brief statement of research interests, and relevant publication samples.

inquiries.title: Research Collaboration
inquiries.text: We actively seek partners across ecology, remote sensing, data science, and climate policy. Reach out with a brief project description.

inquiries.title: Media & Press
inquiries.text: Dr. Duncanson is available for interviews on forest carbon, GEDI, climate change, and remote sensing policy topics.
